subject: English
passage: In an energy technique known as enhanced geothermal systems, engineers inject water into deep layers of hot, dry rock to generate steam that drives electricity-producing turbines. ______ of this approach cite its minimal carbon emissions and its ability to supply continuous power regardless of weather conditions.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation: Choice C is the best answer because it most logically completes the text's discussion of enhanced geothermal systems. As used in this context, 'proponents' means supporters or advocates of something. The text describes enhanced geothermal systems as an energy technique with certain advantages, including minimal carbon emissions and reliable power output. This context supports the idea that proponents, or supporters, of this approach would cite these benefits when promoting the technique.
